notes:
Summary: GrayPeak SupportQuay is a mid‑enterprise customer support SaaS looking to replace an aging search stack for their ticket deflection and agent-assist product. Primary technical driver is accurate top-5 reranking with tight end-to-end latency SLOs.

Key constraints / asks:
- Index scale: ~3M documents (historical tickets + KB + product notes); expect 8-12k daily writes, nightly re-index/refresh window.
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile end-to-end retrieve+rerank < 120ms for agent flows; CTO quote: "cannot accept >150ms to first token for our agent UI."
- Quality target: Product PM wants top-5 precision >85% on internal eval set (reranker + embedding tuning critical).
- Cost sensitivity: target cost per query (retrieve + rerank) < $0.003 average at 500 qps peak per region; concerned about GPU reranker unit economics.
- Model preferences: open to quantized local reranker; prefer Redwood-provided model variants for deterministic performance. Interested in caching of frequent prefixes and hybrid ANN + lexical retrieval.
- Compliance: SSO/SAML mandatory, KMS integration for keys, SOC2 audit evidence required, data residency in NA.

POC ask: GrayPeak will supply 100k representative queries + 200k doc sample (sanitized) for a 2-week POC. They want Redwood to provide:
1) an architecture recommendation (hosted vs dedicated vs private) with performance numbers,
2) cost projection (embeddings + rerank GPU time + storage) and expected cost-per-query at target throughput,
3) latency report (p50/p95/p99) for their dataset, and
4) guidance on index update strategy to meet nightly refresh SLA.

On calls: PM said "top five has to feel like the single source of truth for agents". CTO emphasized deterministic fallbacks and transparent cost modeling.

Stubs/refs: pricing deck on Drive, security answers doc, Fireflies ff_2026-02-18_gpv9x, Jira RINF-4821 opened re: index pipeline questions.

Sales notes / tone: heavy technical scrutiny, procurement timeline likely April; win requires clear Dedicated capacity path + Optimize recommendations that lower reranker cost without hurting top-5 quality.
